title: Removing React.js from the codebase and adapting HTMX for UI interactivity
excerpt: Started by rafalp on Dec. 12, 2023 in the Roadmap category. 6 replies, last one from July 25, 2024.
content_html:
• Here's how Misago works currently:

    1. You request https://misago-project.org.
    2. Django view gathers data to render list of threads.
    3. Django view renders template that contains almost complete HTML with list of threads, but also includes a JSON with same data used to render this HTML. And there is no interactivity because forms are disabled.
    4. JavaScript downloads.
    5. JavaScript runs, reads JSON embedded in the page's body and replaces most of HTML rendered from Django templates with HTML from React.js components. Buttons become active, and timestamps in UI swap.

    This approach has some problems:

    • A lot of pages in Misago are implemented twice: as Django templates and React.js components.
    • People who start customizing HTML get burned because they edit Django templates and see their changes flash for a second on a site before being replaced by React.js HTML which they didn't know they also need to customize.
    • Every view accessible to both users and guests needs to be done twice: as Django view with templates, and as React.js route with components. It also requires an API and JSON serializers to power data fetching.
    • JSON serialization to pre-bake data for React.js app slows down response generation.
    • A large part of translation messages is duplicated, living in both django.po and djangojs.po files. JavaScript translation files also increase the initial download size.
    • Lots of JavaScript can kill performance, especially on older and slower mobile devices.
    • Enabling plugins to replace or inject custom HTML to the page requires for those plugins to implement both Django templates and React.js components. And Misago will need to implement a JavaScript build step as part of site build in misago-docker. Plugin devs need to know both.

    I've considered two solutions to this problem:

    1. Drop Django views and templates, only keep those in minimal versions to keep search engine bots happy. Focus on implementing an API and having all UI as React.js app.
    2. Reduce Django to API and use JavaScript framework with serverside rendering, eg. Next.js or Remix.run.

    But here's a thing: there's a lot of forum software out there that still does the old way of rendering as much as possible on the server and using some JavaScript on client to improve its interactivity here and there. And people are happy with that. And this approach has none of the above issues.

    Internet forum software has plenty of interactivity, but this interactivity is isolated to specific places on the page. Moderation actions, watching a thread, writing a reply, seeing last notifications, voting in a poll. All this stuff can be achieved without React.js and was achieved without it for years before we've decided that full page reload is something that needs to be avoided.

    Now, what's HTMX? HTMX is a tiny library that lets developers specify parts of HTML as dynamic islands that can be swapped by new server-rendered HTML on interaction. For example, list of actual threads is one such (large) island. With little bit of HTMX included in Django template, changing current category on threads list could pull new HTML from Django only for new threads list for selected category, while keeping rest of the page's HTMX (eg. already loaded search results in navbar) unchanged. Misago's backend code would only need to be changed to return only the HTML for this island when request comes from HTMX, instead of full page. There's no need to do any JSON serialization or write dedicated JavaScript or React.js.

    HTMX is declarative way of doing $.get("url", "#outlet") we've did in jQuery 20 years ago. Or Rails Turbolinks. I can't believe I am writing this, but this is the way for forum software if you hate endless scrolling or want to keep things simple otherwise.

  • I've also decided against moving the admin panel to SPA. Currently I have a bunch of reusable Django views that take care of 90% of work, and adding new page to admin requires one to pick right base view, fill in blanks, define one or few forms and write very basic templates for those. Rest happens automagically and I like it.

    The effort required to move away from React.js and to HTMX will be a big one, but it can be done as multiple small steps. Eg. one release could move Navbar to HTMX, other threads list, next thread page, another user profiles, etc. etc. But plugins/permissions/new parser still have to happen first. So HTMX migration will have to wait until later 2024. I am fine with that becasue I would also want to move to latest Bootstrap, and those guys are cooking some crazy stuff in it.

  • For the record, JS sizes from Misago 0.39:

    vendor.js: 679kb, 214kb gzipped
    misago.js: 615kb, 124kb gzipped
    django-i18n.js: 102kb, 25.4kb gzipped

    Misago JS also includes lazily loaded:

    hljs.js: 144kb, 49kb gzipped
    zxcvbn.js: 820kb, 430kb gzipped

    I plan to return to those numbers once I start removing React.js (and other JS dependencies) from Misago.

  • I also need to give a warning that we will likely have a transition period where parts of Misago will have no React.js, but also no HTMX either, effectively making them "multi-page application". This may sound scary but it only means that clicking a link or submitting a form in, say, user options page will cause a full page reload. But I will still write a placeholder AJAX (or just use the HTMX) where full page reload will be absolutely unbearable, eg. for liking posts or voting in polls.

  • "Forum options" page has been replaced with "Account settings". This new page is done fully with Django views, and uses HTMX on some pages for dynamic updates.

    JS size change:

    misago.js: 578kb, 107kb gzipped (37kb/17kb less)

  • Threads lists have been rewritten almost from scratch to use Django views and HTMX instead of React.js.

    JS size change:

    misago.js: 530kb, 99kb gzipped (48kb/8kb less)

sentences.zh: 启用插件替换自定义 HTML 或将自定义 HTML 注入到页面需要这些插件实现 Django 模板和 React.js 组件。

sentences.en: And Misago will need to implement a JavaScript build step as part of site build in misago-docker.
sentences.zh: Misago 需要实现 JavaScript 构建步骤，作为 Misago-docker 中站点构建的一部分。

sentences.en: Plugin devs need to know both.
sentences.zh: 插件开发人员需要两者都了解。

blocks.html_en: I've considered two solutions to this problem:

sentences.en: I've considered two solutions to this problem:
sentences.zh: 我考虑过解决这个问题的两种方法：

blocks.html_en: • Drop Django views and templates, only keep those in minimal versions to keep search engine bots happy. Focus on implementing an API and having all UI as React.js app.

sentences.en: Drop Django views and templates, only keep those in minimal versions to keep search engine bots happy.
sentences.zh: 删除 Django 视图和模板，只保留最小版本，以使搜索引擎机器人满意。

sentences.en: Focus on implementing an API and having all UI as React.js app.
sentences.zh: 专注于实现 API 并将所有 UI 作为 React.js 应用程序。

blocks.html_en: • Reduce Django to API and use JavaScript framework with serverside rendering, eg. Next.js or Remix.run.

sentences.en: Reduce Django to API and use JavaScript framework with serverside rendering, eg.
sentences.zh: 将 Django 简化为 API 并使用 JavaScript 框架进行服务器端渲染，例如。

sentences.en: Next.js or Remix.run.
sentences.zh: Next.js 或 Remix.run。

blocks.html_en: But here's a thing: there's a lot of forum software out there that still does the old way of rendering as much as possible on the server and using some JavaScript on client to improve its interactivity here and there. And people are happy with that. And this approach has none of the above issues.

sentences.en: But here's a thing: there's a lot of forum software out there that still does the old way of rendering as much as possible on the server and using some JavaScript on client to improve its interactivity here and there.
sentences.zh: 但有一点是：有很多论坛软件仍然采用旧的方式在服务器上尽可能多地进行渲染，并在客户端上使用一些 JavaScript 来提高其交互性。

sentences.en: And people are happy with that.
sentences.zh: 人们对此感到高兴。

sentences.en: And this approach has none of the above issues.
sentences.zh: 而这种方法不存在上述问题。

blocks.html_en: Internet forum software has plenty of interactivity, but this interactivity is isolated to specific places on the page. Moderation actions, watching a thread, writing a reply, seeing last notifications, voting in a poll. All this stuff can be achieved without React.js and was achieved without it for years before we've decided that full page reload is something that needs to be avoided.

sentences.en: Internet forum software has plenty of interactivity, but this interactivity is isolated to specific places on the page.
sentences.zh: 互联网论坛软件具有大量的交互性，但这种交互性被隔离在页面上的特定位置。

sentences.en: Moderation actions, watching a thread, writing a reply, seeing last notifications, voting in a poll.
sentences.zh: 审核操作、观看主题、撰写回复、查看最新通知、在民意调查中投票。

sentences.en: All this stuff can be achieved without React.js and was achieved without it for years before we've decided that full page reload is something that needs to be avoided.
sentences.zh: 所有这些东西都可以在没有 React.js 的情况下实现，并且在我们决定需要避免整页重新加载之前，已经在没有它的情况下实现了多年。

blocks.html_en: Now, what's HTMX? HTMX is a tiny library that lets developers specify parts of HTML as dynamic islands that can be swapped by new server-rendered HTML on interaction. For example, list of actual threads is one such (large) island. With little bit of HTMX included in Django template, changing current category on threads list could pull new HTML from Django only for new threads list for selected category, while keeping rest of the page's HTMX (eg. already loaded search results in navbar) unchanged. Misago's backend code would only need to be changed to return only the HTML for this island when request comes from HTMX, instead of full page. There's no need to do any JSON serialization or write dedicated JavaScript or React.js.

sentences.en: Now, what's HTMX?
sentences.zh: 现在，什么是 HTMX？

sentences.en: HTMX is a tiny library that lets developers specify parts of HTML as dynamic islands that can be swapped by new server-rendered HTML on interaction.
sentences.zh: HTMX 是一个小型库，可让开发人员将 HTML 的各个部分指定为动态岛，这些动态岛可以在交互时由新的服务器呈现的 HTML 进行交换。

sentences.en: For example, list of actual threads is one such (large) island.
sentences.zh: 例如，实际线程列表就是这样一个（大）岛。

sentences.en: With little bit of HTMX included in Django template, changing current category on threads list could pull new HTML from Django only for new threads list for selected category, while keeping rest of the page's HTMX (eg.
sentences.zh: 由于 Django 模板中包含少量 HTMX，更改线程列表上的当前类别可以仅从 Django 中为所选类别的新线程列表提取新的 HTML，同时保留页面的 HTMX 的其余部分（例如

sentences.en: already loaded search results in navbar) unchanged.
sentences.zh: 已在导航栏中加载搜索结果）不变。

sentences.en: Misago's backend code would only need to be changed to return only the HTML for this island when request comes from HTMX, instead of full page.
sentences.zh: Misago 的后端代码只需要更改为当请求来自 HTMX 时仅返回该岛的 HTML，而不是完整页面。

sentences.en: There's no need to do any JSON serialization or write dedicated JavaScript or React.js.
sentences.zh: 无需执行任何 JSON 序列化或编写专用 JavaScript 或 React.js。

blocks.html_en: HTMX is declarative way of doing $.get("url", "#outlet") we've did in jQuery 20 years ago. Or Rails Turbolinks. I can't believe I am writing this, but this is the way for forum software if you hate endless scrolling or want to keep things simple otherwise.

sentences.en: HTMX is declarative way of doing $.get("url", "#outlet") we've did in jQuery 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: HTMX 是我们 20 年前在 jQuery 中使用的 $.get("url", "#outlet") 的声明方式。

sentences.en: Or Rails Turbolinks.
sentences.zh: 或者 Rails Turbolinks。

sentences.en: I can't believe I am writing this, but this is the way for forum software if you hate endless scrolling or want to keep things simple otherwise.
sentences.zh: 我不敢相信我正在写这篇文章，但如果您讨厌无休止的滚动或想让事情变得简单，这就是论坛软件的方式。

blocks.html_en:
• I've also decided against moving the admin panel to SPA. Currently I have a bunch of reusable Django views that take care of 90% of work, and adding new page to admin requires one to pick right base view, fill in blanks, define one or few forms and write very basic templates for those. Rest happens automagically and I like it.

    The effort required to move away from React.js and to HTMX will be a big one, but it can be done as multiple small steps. Eg. one release could move Navbar to HTMX, other threads list, next thread page, another user profiles, etc. etc. But plugins/permissions/new parser still have to happen first. So HTMX migration will have to wait until later 2024. I am fine with that becasue I would also want to move to latest Bootstrap, and those guys are cooking some crazy stuff in it.

blocks.html_en: • I also need to give a warning that we will likely have a transition period where parts of Misago will have no React.js, but also no HTMX either, effectively making them "multi-page application". This may sound scary but it only means that clicking a link or submitting a form in, say, user options page will cause a full page reload. But I will still write a placeholder AJAX (or just use the HTMX) where full page reload will be absolutely unbearable, eg. for liking posts or voting in polls.

• Misago 目前的工作方式如下：您请求 https://misago-project.org。 Django 视图收集数据来呈现线程列表。 Django 视图呈现模板，其中包含几乎完整的 HTML 和线程列表，但还包含一个 JSON，其中包含用于呈现此 HTML 的相同数据。 而且由于表单被禁用，因此没有交互性。 JavaScript 下载。 JavaScript 运行，读取嵌入在页面主体中的 JSON，并用 React.js 组件中的 HTML 替换从 Django 模板呈现的大部分 HTML。 按钮变为活动状态，并且 UI 中的时间戳交换。 这种方法有一些问题： Misago 中的许多页面都实现了两次：作为 Django 模板和 React.js 组件。 开始自定义 HTML 的人会被烧伤，因为他们编辑 Django 模板并看到他们的更改在网站上闪烁一秒钟，然后被 React.js HTML 取代，他们不知道自己也需要自定义。 用户和来宾均可访问的每个视图都需要完成两次：作为带有模板的 Django 视图，以及作为带有组件的 React.js 路由。 它还需要 API 和 JSON 序列化器来支持数据获取。 用于为 React.js 应用程序预烘焙数据的 JSON 序列化会减慢响应生成速度。 很大一部分翻译消息是重复的，存在于 django.po 和 djangojs.po 文件中。 JavaScript 翻译文件也会增加初始下载大小。 大量 JavaScript 会降低性能，尤其是在较旧且速度较慢的移动设备上。 启用插件替换自定义 HTML 或将自定义 HTML 注入到页面需要这些插件实现 Django 模板和 React.js 组件。 Misago 需要实现 JavaScript 构建步骤，作为 Misago-docker 中站点构建的一部分。 插件开发人员需要两者都了解。 我考虑过解决这个问题的两种方法：删除 Django 视图和模板，只保留最小版本，以使搜索引擎机器人满意。 专注于实现 API 并将所有 UI 作为 React.js 应用程序。 将 Django 简化为 API 并使用 JavaScript 框架进行服务器端渲染，例如。 Next.js 或 Remix.run。 但有一点是：有很多论坛软件仍然采用旧的方式在服务器上尽可能多地进行渲染，并在客户端上使用一些 JavaScript 来提高其交互性。 人们对此感到高兴。 而这种方法不存在上述问题。 互联网论坛软件具有大量的交互性，但这种交互性被隔离在页面上的特定位置。 审核操作、观看主题、撰写回复、查看最新通知、在民意调查中投票。 所有这些东西都可以在没有 React.js 的情况下实现，并且在我们决定需要避免整页重新加载之前，已经在没有它的情况下实现了多年。 现在，什么是 HTMX？ HTMX 是一个小型库，可让开发人员将 HTML 的各个部分指定为动态岛，这些动态岛可以在交互时由新的服务器呈现的 HTML 进行交换。 例如，实际线程列表就是这样一个（大）岛。 由于 Django 模板中包含少量 HTMX，更改线程列表上的当前类别可以仅从 Django 中为所选类别的新线程列表提取新的 HTML，同时保留页面的 HTMX 的其余部分（例如 已在导航栏中加载搜索结果）不变。 Misago 的后端代码只需要更改为当请求来自 HTMX 时仅返回该岛的 HTML，而不是完整页面。 无需执行任何 JSON 序列化或编写专用 JavaScript 或 React.js。 HTMX 是我们 20 年前在 jQuery 中使用的 $.get("url", "#outlet") 的声明方式。 或者 Rails Turbolinks。 我不敢相信我正在写这篇文章，但如果您讨厌无休止的滚动或想让事情变得简单，这就是论坛软件的方式。
  • 我还决定不将管理面板移至 SPA。 目前，我有一堆可重用的 Django 视图，可以处理 90% 的工作，向管理添加新页面需要选择正确的基本视图、填写空白、定义一个或几个表单并为这些表单编写非常基本的模板。 休息会自动发生，我喜欢它。 从 React.js 转向 HTMX 所需的努力将是一项巨大的工作，但它可以通过多个小步骤来完成。 例如。 一个版本可以将导航栏移动到 HTMX、其他线程列表、下一个线程页面、另一个用户配置文件等。但是插件/权限/新解析器仍然必须首先发生。 因此 HTMX 迁移必须等到 2024 年晚些时候。 我对此很满意，因为我也想迁移到最新的 Bootstrap，而那些人正在其中烹饪一些疯狂的东西。
  • 根据记录，Misago 0.39 中的 JS 大小：vendor.js：679kb、214kb gzipped Misago.js：615kb、124kb gzipped django-i18n.js：102kb、25.4kb gzipped Misago JS 还包括延迟加载：hljs.js：144kb、49kb gzipped zxcvbn.js：820kb、430kb gzipped 我计划在开始从 Misago 中删除 React.js（和其他 JS 依赖项）后返回到这些数字。
  • 我还需要警告，我们可能会有一个过渡期，Misago 的部分内容将没有 React.js，也没有 HTMX，从而有效地使它们成为“多页面应用程序”。 这可能听起来很可怕，但这仅意味着单击链接或在用户选项页面中提交表单将导致整个页面重新加载。 但我仍然会编写一个占位符 AJAX（或者只使用 HTMX），其中整页重新加载将是绝对无法忍受的，例如。 喜欢帖子或在民意调查中投票。
  • “论坛选项”页面已替换为“帐户设置”。 这个新页面完全使用 Django 视图完成，并在某些页面上使用 HTMX 进行动态更新。 JS 大小更改：misago.js：578kb，gzip 压缩后 107kb（减少 37kb/17kb）
  • 线程列表几乎从头开始重写，使用 Django 视图和 HTMX 而不是 React.js。 JS 大小更改：misago.js：530kb，gzip 压缩后的 99kb（减少 48kb/8kb）
